description:
Job Family : 
Software Development & Support 
 Travel Required : 
None 
 Clearance Required : 
Ability to Obtain Public Trust 
 
 Overview 
 We are seeking a Full Stack Engineer to build, maintain, and modernize NLM’s Value Set Authority Center (VSAC) systems. This role supports VSAC web applications, terminology services, value set authoring, APIs, search, scheduled jobs, content/document management, and healthcare data pipelines.
 The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with React, Node.js, Java/Spring, Oracle, Elasticsearch, GitLab CI, AWS, Quartz Scheduler, and Alfresco CMS/ECM in a secure enterprise environment.
 
 What You Will Do 
 Build and maintain VSAC applications using React, Node.js, Java, and Spring.

 Develop secure REST APIs for value set search, retrieval, download, validation, authoring, publishing, and administration.

 Maintain Oracle-backed services, database schemas, SQL/PLSQL logic, indexes, and performance tuning.

 Build and optimize Elasticsearch indexes for value sets, codes, terms, metadata, versions, and terminology content.

 Develop Quartz-based jobs for terminology processing, validation, synchronization, indexing, reporting, cleanup, and maintenance.

 Integrate VSAC systems with Alfresco CMS/ECM for documents, downloadable assets, metadata, and content workflows.

 Build ingestion and transformation pipelines for clinical vocabularies, value sets, XML/JSON files, SQL exports, and terminology releases.

 Implement secure authentication, authorization, access control, session handling, and API security.

 Maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines and support AWS-based deployments, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident response.

 
 What you Will Need 
 Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related field.

 Experience with Git/GitLab, REST APIs, Linux environments, and collaborative development.

 Minimum of FIVE (5) years of full stack engineering experience.

 Strong frontend experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, reusable components, and responsive UI design.

 Experience with Git/GitLab, REST APIs, Linux environments, and collaborative development.

 Backend experience with Node.js and Java/Spring, including secure REST APIs, authentication, authorization, and service-layer development.

 Experience with Git/GitLab, REST APIs, Linux environments, and collaborative development.

 Strong Oracle experience, including SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, packages, triggers, views, indexing, and performance tuning.

 Elasticsearch experience, including index design, query tuning, reindexing, and synchronization with Oracle or other systems of record.

 Experience with Quartz Scheduler for batch processing, scheduled jobs, retry logic, monitoring, and recurring maintenance tasks.

 Experience with Alfresco CMS/ECM for document management, content storage, metadata, workflows, retrieval, and publishing.

 Experience building data pipelines for healthcare, terminology, XML, JSON, and database-export data.

 Experience with GitLab CI/CD, AWS deployment, monitoring, release management, rollback planning, and production support.

 Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, clinical vocabularies, value sets, terminology services, or federal health systems.

 
 Nice-to-Have Skills 
 Familiarity with VSAC, UMLS, RxNorm, SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD, CPT, HCPCS, FHIR, HL7, eCQM, CMS quality programs, or CQL.

 Experience with Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate, Maven/Gradle, and Java microservices.

 Experience with testing tools such as Selenium, JUnit, Cucumber, or API testing frameworks.

 Experience with Alfresco APIs, content models, permissions, metadata extraction, document workflows, and ECM integrations.

 Experience with Quartz clustering, job recovery, cron expressions, batch jobs, and operational monitoring.

 Technologies Commonly Used 
 Frontend: React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS

 Backend: Node.js, Java, Spring, Spring Boot

 Database: Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL

 Search: Elasticsearch

 Jobs: Quartz Scheduler, cron, batch processing

 Content Management: Alfresco CMS/ECM

 DevOps/Cloud: GitLab CI/CD, Linux, AWS

 Testing: Selenium, JUnit, Cucumber

 Healthcare/Terminology: VSAC, UMLS, value sets, RxNorm, SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD, CPT, HCPCS

 
 
The annual salary range for this position is $98,000.00-$163,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. 
 What We Offer: 
 Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.
 
 Benefits include:
 Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance

 Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

 Parental Leave

 401(k) Retirement Plan

 Group Term Life and Travel Assistance

 Voluntary Life and AD&D Insurance

 Health Savings Account, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

 Transit and Parking Commuter Benefits

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development, Certifications & Learning Opportunities

 Employee Referral Program

 Corporate Sponsored Events & Community Outreach

 Care.com annual membership

 Employee Assistance Program

 Supplemental Benefits via Corestream (Critical Care, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Legal Assistance and ID theft protection, etc.)

 Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus

 
 About Guidehouse 
 Guidehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer–Protected Veterans, Individuals with Disabilities or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.
 
 Guidehouse will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable law or ordinance including the Fair Chance Ordinance of Los Angeles and San Francisco.
 
 If you have visited our website for information about employment opportunities, or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Guidehouse Recruiting at 1-571-633-1711 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@guidehouse.com . All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodation.
